notes.title: Button City Soccer Days Revealed at Wholesome Direct 2023!
notes.content:
We're excited to give you the very first glimpse at our next Button City project --[b] Button City Soccer Days![/b] We just showed this reveal trailer exclusively at the Wholesome Direct 2023 Preshow 💜

[previewyoutube=1r_A4y0OAKI;full][/previewyoutube]
Soccer mania has come to Button City! People all over town are forming teams to play in the new Open Soccer Tournament. Fennel the fox and his scrappy group of friends team up in this charming soccer adventure, with an engaging story and adorable action gameplay!

Plan your training in the story portions: Bond with your friends, manage your teammates, and make choices that impact your game and narrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37894276/e99f952f5cd3eb315eb6d76adbddf8a478a0b25e.gif[/img]
Enjoy arcadey, action-packed soccer matches against rival teams, while also being ready for the unexpected! Overcome bad weather, injuries, and red cards that will affect the team's season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37894276/637c8bbc403a1246ebdc1a2acb9d2c9473bb67de.gif[/img]

That's all we can tell you for now -- but we hope you're excited to see some familiar fuzzy faces in Button City Soccer Days!
